name: Lil T Jones Dance AI: Make Your Baby, You or Your Pet Do the Lil T Jones
blurb: The Lil T Jones dance is a TikTok dance from October 2026 to "Lil TJones", a 2010 club song by BeatKing: a hand over the mouth, a salute, bouncy knees, a half turn and a deep bend.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: kling-3-motion, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Track the exact camera movement, framing, facial expressions and body movements from the video. Keep the face, hairstyle, body, clothing and overall appearance of the baby in the reference image exactly the same, with no changes or distortion, and keep the background from the reference image. Keep every move of the dance in time with the beat: the salute, both hands over the mouth, the bounce on bent knees, the half turn with one knee up and the grin.
Matching the video second by second: 0-1 s the baby stands with the hands at the chest; 1-3 s one hand over the mouth with a shy grin; 3-4 s the palms pressed together at the chest; 4-5 s one hand flicked up beside the head like a salute, with a big grin; 5-7 s the bounce on bent knees with a little kick; 7-8 s the half turn with one knee up; 8-11 s a hand on the chest, then one arm waved high over the head; 11-15 s a lean to the side, a deep bend forward from the hips and the drop into a low squat.
Natural proportions for the baby in the photo: a small chubby body, a big round head, short arms and legs and small baby hands, never an adult body, even in the deep bend and the squat. No text or captions. No black T-shirt, no navy shorts, no white socks, no beige slides and no beard unless the reference image shows them. Exactly one baby, no extra people. Output in 9:16 vertical format.

prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same living room with the cream sectional sofa, the wooden coffee table with the small vase of orange flowers, the pink patterned rug and the shelf with two framed pictures, the same evening light, the same fixed phone camera, framing, timing and dance moves, one continuous take with no cuts. The ONLY change: the man in the black T-shirt and navy shorts who dances in the middle of the room is now the pet in [Image 1]. [Image 1] is the sole look reference for the pet; [Video 1] is for the moves, the room and the camera only.

The dancer = the pet in [Image 1], whole body, in EVERY frame: the same species and breed, head shape, muzzle, eyes, ears, fur colors, fur length and markings as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything, so its owner instantly recognizes it. It stands upright on its hind legs like a person the whole time. A dog stays a dog and a cat stays a cat. No T-shirt, no shorts, no socks, no slides and no clothes unless [Image 1] shows them, no human face, no human hands. Never drift back to the man of the original video.

The woman who lies on the sofa behind with her phone stays exactly as in the video and never takes the look of [Image 1].

Track the exact camera movement, framing, facial expressions and body movements from the video, and keep every move of the dance in time with the beat: the salute, both front paws over the mouth, the bounce on bent knees, the half turn and the grin. Matching the reference second by second:
0-1 s: it stands with the front paws at the chest.
1-3 s: one front paw over the mouth, a shy look.
3-4 s: both front paws pressed together at the chest.
4-5 s: one front paw flicked up beside the head like a salute.
5-7 s: the bounce on bent hind legs with a little kick.
7-8 s: the half turn with one hind leg up.
8-11 s: a paw on the chest, then one front leg waved high over the head.
11-15 s: a lean to the side, a deep bend forward and the drop into a low squat.

Anatomy rules: one head only, one muzzle, natural teeth and tongue. Two hind legs and two front legs, furry paws covered in the pet's own fur, never human hands or fingers, no extra legs or paws. Exactly one animal, no extra people. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
